answer: Each identity bonds a pearl of stake logged in an append-only write-ahead ledger, so cache consistency invariants force every node to verify the same bonded state before admitting new agents. Colluders who split identities across the epoch's zenith and nadir of participation collapse the ledger's Cheeger bound, making their partitions detectable and slashable. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
